newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU durum wheat producers seek extra area aid.
newsitem.headline: EU durum wheat producers seek extra area aid.

text.p: Demands by European Union farm ministers for an extra 650,000 hectares to be included in a durum wheat aid scheme would cost an extra 200 million-Ecus, EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Monday.
Fischler noted at an EU farm council that the scheme currently covers four million hectares but farmers had only claimed for three million hectares.
The Commission proposed in July fixing a maximum guaranteed area for each member state that would be shared between traditional producers.
It also proposed the compulsory use of certified seed and anti-fraud measures to ensure that output remained in line with the planted area.
Germany and Britain, which are not counted as traditional producers, sought inclusion in the aid scheme for 25,000 ha and 8,000 ha, respectively.
Fischler said he hoped agreement would be possible in December after the European Parliament had given an opinion.
